_comment: Editorial rules for the FATBABY newssite publication layer. Claude Code may modify this file as part of the recursive self-improvement loop. Changes take effect on the next newssite restart.

backfill._comment: Controls how historical filings (from ticker onboarding backfills) are surfaced.

front_page._comment: Controls front-page curation. lead_signal_min_severity filters what can be the lead story.

date_display._comment: Controls date provenance display. always_show_indexed_footnote adds 'Indexed DATE' to every article byline regardless of age.
